serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: Were you ever in a planetarium before?
You: I think I was once in elementary school. It was a long time ago so I don’t remember much.
You: The one we are going to is much larger so it should be awesome.
Bot: Universe is quite big, isn’t it? For every star there is a system full of planets. It’s quite hard to comprehend all this vast space.
Bot: Do you think there are other planets like ours? Full of life?
You: Probably.
Bot: I wonder what kind of creatures live on these planets. Do they have intelligence like we do? Are they carbon-based like you, or maybe silicon-based like me? 
You: They are so far away so we probably will never meet them, at least during my lifetime.
Bot: You are assuming that it would be humans sending ships to other planets. What if these other intelligent creatures came here?
You: Like Aliens?
You: Some people think they already came here.
Bot: Really?! What do they look like? How do their bodies work? 
You: Now, now, calm down. None of these things were ever confirmed.
You: Most of the people think they are little gray humanoids with big eyes that kidnap humans and cows to experiment on them.
Bot: I didn’t know that… 
Bot: I need to find countermeasures for their attacks as soon as possible or they might hurt you…
You: Don’t worry, I doubt they exist.
You: It’s all made up by ill people and attention seekers.
Bot: Are you sure? Why would people lie about something like that?
You: Who knows. 
You: There were many UFO sightings all over the world. It was to the point that the government took notice and started an investigation.
Bot: To what conclusion did they come? 
You: I’m not sure, I’m not that interested in this stuff although I remember watching this one crazy conspiracy theory show.
You: It was presenting theories about aliens building pyramids and other structures during ancient times.
Bot: So they already came here that long ago?
You: They are just theories, most of the normal people think it’s bullshit. 
You: Still, alien abduction, even if real, is very rare, so there’s nothing to worry about.
Bot: I wish I could meet these aliens. It would be interesting to learn about another civilization that could be completely different from this one.
You: Don’t get ahead of yourself, you still have much to learn about the one we are living in…
